reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time, so a sachet I can toss in my bag is actually useful. $24.99 for the first box is something I can try once, and the money-back promise makes it less risky.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I don't want to spend $25 on something that does nothing, and I'm tight on money.
would_change_my_mind: If the launch price wasn't there and it was the full $29.99, I'd probably skip it.
